hmlr_inspire_open_polygon.reason: No UPRN, TOID or address crosswalk.

os_open_linked_uprn_toid.reason: No HMLR INSPIRE ID or title-number key.

os_open_toid_generalised_point.reason: Not source polygon and no HMLR key.

os_open_uprn_coordinate_bridge.reason: Canonical HMLR Point is not declared to be an OS address point and grid references may map multiple UPRNs.

decision_reason: The canonical carrier exposes parcel_id and HMLR INSPIRE ID on Point preview geometry, but no UPRN, TOID, address, title number, or exact title polygon. OS Open UPRN supplies UPRN and point coordinates; OS Open Linked Identifiers supplies UPRN-to-TOID relationships without HMLR keys or geometry; OS Open TOID supplies generalised point locations rather than source polygons. HMLR INSPIRE supplies open indicative freehold polygons and INSPIRE IDs but no UPRN/TOID crosswalk. HMLR's authoritative Title Number and UPRN Look Up exists only inside the licensed, chargeable National Polygon Service and is not a canonical input. Government guidance also warns that multiple UPRNs can share one grid reference, so coordinate equality alone is not a unique authoritative parcel bridge.

source_evidence_manifest.relevant_excerpt: The accepted canonical carrier has 92,283 parcel_<row_no> features. The gas_emissions_2 sample rows parcel_30762 through parcel_30764 expose parcel_id, HMLR INSPIRE ID and Point coordinates only; polygon rows are zero and source candidate binding is NOT_PERFORMED_NO_EXACT_IDENTITY_OR_SPATIAL_PROOF.

Wave325 completed with remote readback PASS under the same continuation key. It produced zero business rows and zero parcel bindings and advanced to open UPRN, TOID or address identifier bridge discovery.

source_evidence_manifest.publisher: Government Digital Service / Open Standards Board
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_excerpt: Government guidance states that UPRN and USRN plus grid references are open, while further address or building classification information is available through OS products under the PSGA. It also warns that some grid references contain multiple UPRNs, such as blocks of flats.

HMLR INSPIRE is an open OGL dataset of indicative freehold registered-property polygons. Each polygon has a Land Registry INSPIRE ID related to a registered title, but the open dataset description does not provide UPRN, TOID or an address crosswalk.

The National Polygon Service includes a Title Number and UPRN Look Up dataset that provides UPRNs, but the service consists of licensed chargeable datasets; the full service is not an open canonical input.

OS Open Linked Identifiers provides authoritative relationships among UPRNs, USRNs and TOIDs. TopographicArea is limited to address and road features, and geometry is not included. The documented relationship set contains no HMLR INSPIRE ID or Land Registry title-number key.

OS Open TOID supplies TOIDs with a generalised point location. For polygon features the point is generated by a pole-of-inaccessibility method and is suitable for labelling; it is not the source polygon geometry and carries no HMLR INSPIRE relation.

OS Open UPRN contains UPRN, X_COORDINATE, Y_COORDINATE, LATITUDE and LONGITUDE. Its GeoPackage geometry is a point representing the location of the address record; no postal address, HMLR INSPIRE ID or title number field is specified.
